simple.meaning: בֶּצֶר (betser) is a Hebrew word meaning “strictly a clipping , i.e. gold (as dug out).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּצֶר (H1220) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 22:24, with occurrences in Job.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּצֶר (H1220) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּצֶר (H1220) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּצֶר (betser) / H1220 is traced through Job 22:24, Job 22:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
